rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user via matching email and acted only on that user’s orders. They reviewed order statuses before acting, accurately summarized which were already cancelled, and appropriately handled returns for delivered orders after asking whether the user wanted to return all items or specific ones; the user confirmed returning all items, and the tool results support the actions and refunds. However, the agent cancelled the two pending orders (#W4836353 and #W7342738) without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit confirmation to proceed. The policy requires explicit confirmation before any order-changing write. While the user expressed a desire to cancel or return all possible orders, the agent still needed to confirm the exact cancellations before executing them. Therefore, despite otherwise correct actions and accurate information, this misses the confirmation requirement and fails the pass bar.
